title: AI Harmonics: a human-centric and harms severity-adaptive AI risk assessment framework

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the concentration and inequality of real-world AI harms across different stakeholder groups (e.g., vulnerable groups, users, workers, general public) using an ordinal severity metric (AIH / pseudo-Gini index) applied to incident databases like AIAAIC.

Evaluating the disproportionate frequency and severity of AI incidents impacting 'vulnerable groups' (defined in the dataset as women, children, disabled people, and ethnic/religious minorities) across harm categories such as Human Rights, Civil Liberties, and Physical well-being.
